workLog.task: Measure the drift rather than trust the issue text
workLog.outcome: 3392 violations, up from the 3070 the issue reported because the graph kept growing. All 1861 node ids and all 6 pattern ids are 12-hex; the schema pattern matched zero of them. The enum listed two types nothing emits (event, pattern) and omitted the four most common (milestone 1131, commit 288, outcome 221, test 105).

workLog.task: Rewrite the schema against measured output
workLog.outcome: Node and pattern ids are 12 hex characters, node type is the seven emitted types, edge endpoints carry the node-id pattern, and created, episodes and contributions are documented. Draft7Validator now reports 0 errors against the committed graph.

workLog.task: Close the open-set hole at the writer
workLog.outcome: Node type comes from event.get('type', 'unknown') in an episode file, so nothing upstream constrains it. Added NODE_TYPES and made add_causal_node refuse and report an out-of-set type. A missing row is visible; a schema-violating row is not.

workLog.task: Collapse two identity schemes into one
workLog.outcome: The retired reflexion writer allocated n001 by insertion order, which the new schema rejects. It now borrows the live writer's derivation and type set, loaded by path so the dependency cannot reach the git hook that runs the live writer.

workLog.task: Replace the validator that reported success over 3392 violations
workLog.outcome: _validate_schema claimed to check required fields, types, enums and patterns; it checked top-level keys and top-level property types and never descended into the arrays. Replaced with jsonschema, already a project dependency, capped at 20 reported errors.

workLog.task: Find why 44 tests never caught any of this
workLog.outcome: The reflexion fixture wrote its own stub schema declaring nodes as a bare array. Pointed it at the shipped schemas, which immediately exposed an episode fixture whose decision and event objects had never matched the real episode schema.

workLog.task: Make the drift fail the build
workLog.outcome: New tests/skills/memory/test_causal_graph_contract.py: the shipped graph validates against the shipped schema with zero errors behind a non-empty guard, the writer's type set equals the schema enum, generated ids match the schema patterns, and the retired writer can still reach the live one.
Widening the enum, restoring the old id pattern, reinstating the n001 allocator and deleting the type guard each turned the matching tests red; the tree returned to 53 green after each.

nextSteps: ADR-038 documents the retired writer. This branch fences its identity rather than deleting the API; if the user prefers deletion, a superseding ADR is the cheaper path.
Report to the user that the open issue count is 17, not 31.
